summary: Fixes pre-existing fall-through bug in seedRowForTable switch (case 'effect_resource' was missing a break, causing every effect_resource seed to also call seedOutboxRow). Adds eslint no-fallthrough guard targeting ci/checks/db/**/*.ts so this class of bug is caught at lint time going forward. Nit R-N1 (misleading comment in eslint block) fixed at 05064c5. Full gate: tsc exit 0, eslint src exit 0, vitest 1385/1385, fitness:db 599/599. REVIEW approved (iter 1).
